issue.title: Flaky test_save_atomically_replaces_existing_state under full parallel lane
issue.description: REPRODUCTION: During finish_flat_pane_query_migration verification on 2026-08-15, just check escalated to the governed full suite because the Justfile changed and failed tests/ace/tui/test_config_center_state.py::test_save_atomically_replaces_existing_state under the 14-worker lane. The same node passed immediately afterward in a focused rerun together with the other full-suite failure: '.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_procs_service.py::test_settlement_resumes_after_an_injected_crash tests/ace/tui/test_config_center_state.py::test_save_atomically_replaces_existing_state -q' -> 2 passed in 1.54s. IMPACT: unrelated agents cannot get a green just check when the full-suite lane trips this pass-isolation config-center state failure. SCOPE: reproduce under parallel/full-suite conditions, identify the state or filesystem timing dependency in config-center state persistence, and make the test deterministic without weakening its atomic replace assertion.
